preconditions.description: The number of operations n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(t in [1, 2, 3] for t in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in lines[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each operation type t_i is 1, 2, or 3.

preconditions.expression: all(abs(x) <= 1000 for line in lines[1:] if int(line.split()[0]) == 1 for x in [int(line.split()[2])])
preconditions.description: For type 1 operations, the value x_i satisfies |x_i| <= 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(a >= 1 for line in lines[1:] if int(line.split()[0]) == 1 for a in [int(line.split()[1])])
preconditions.description: For type 1 operations, the count a_i is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(abs(k) <= 1000 for line in lines[1:] if int(line.split()[0]) == 2 for k in [int(line.split()[1])])
preconditions.description: For type 2 operations, the value k_i satisfies |k_i| <= 1000.
It is guaranteed that all operations are valid (no out-of-bounds access) and the sequence always has at least one element after each operation.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines, one for each operation.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(float(stdout_lines[i]) - (current_sum[i] / current_len[i])) <= 1e-6 or abs(float(stdout_lines[i]) - (current_sum[i] / current_len[i])) / max(1.0, abs(current_sum[i] / current_len[i])) <= 1e-6 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output line i represents the average of the sequence after the i-th operation, with absolute or relative error not exceeding 10^-6.

postconditions.expression: current_len[0] == 1 and current_sum[0] == (0 if op_type[0] == 2 else 0) + (0 if op_type[0] == 1 else 0)
postconditions.description: The initial state before any operation is a sequence [0], and the first operation updates the sequence correctly based on its type.

postconditions.expression: all((current_len[i] == current_len[i-1] + 1 and current_sum[i] == current_sum[i-1] + k_val[i]) if op_type[i] == 2 else (current_len[i] == current_len[i-1] - 1 and current_sum[i] == current_sum[i-1] - last_val[i]) if op_type[i] == 3 else (current_len[i] == current_len[i-1] and current_sum[i] == current_sum[i-1] + a_val[i] * x_val[i]) for i in range(1, n))
postconditions.description: For each operation i > 0, the length and sum of the sequence are updated correctly: type 2 appends k_i, type 3 removes the last element, and type 1 adds x_i to the first a_i elements.
